# Titanix

> Titanix is a two-person iOS product studio (est. 2021), a designer and a developer, with five apps of its own on the App Store. It takes other people's apps, from an idea or an AI-built prototype that is stuck in App Review, to approved and paying, and builds the hardware side of connected products (firmware, LoRa, sensors) with the app. Website: https://www.titanix.dev

## People

- **Menan Sali**, co-founder. Computer Science graduate (South East European University); builds native iOS apps and their backends, and RF/IoT systems. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/menansali/ · GitHub: https://github.com/menansali

## What we do

- **iOS Apps** — Native iOS applications in Swift & SwiftUI: on-device and cloud AI, WidgetKit, Live Activities, StoreKit subscriptions, full App Store launches.
- **SaaS Platforms** — End-to-end web products: auth, billing, multi-tenant dashboards, APIs, real-time data. Typical stack: Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Stripe.
- **Hardware + app** — Connected products end to end: embedded firmware, LoRa/BLE/Wi-Fi links, sensor data pipelines, and the native iOS app. Details: https://www.titanix.dev/hardware

## Shipped products

- **Lovly: Lock Screen Drawing** (iOS, Lifestyle/Social) — couples app with a shared drawing canvas, moods and love notes on each partner's Lock Screen. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/lovly — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760272304
- **Memopix: Shape Photo Collage** (iOS, Photo & Video) — turns 20-60 photos into shaped photo-collage keepsakes across 34 templates, print-ready as PNG, JPEG or PDF. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/memopix — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6789686385
- **Tevekkul Vakti: Daily Ayah** (iOS, Lifestyle/Reference; formerly Qaza Qada) — splits the day into six moments set by local prayer times, each with a Qur'an verse chosen for that hour, on the Lock Screen, Home Screen and StandBy; also prayer times, Qibla, tasbih and a missed-prayer calculator. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/tevekkul-vakti — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757791803
- **Aer: Air Quality** (iOS, Weather/Health) — live AQI for 35 cities in North Macedonia with a 7-day Copernicus (CAMS) forecast, alerts and widgets. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/aer — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6790945433
- **Pet Portraits: AI Dog & Cat** (iOS, AI) — turns one dog or cat photo into gallery-grade AI portraits and animated Living Portraits. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/pet-portraits — App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6793742748
- **skeniraj.mk** (SaaS, Hospitality) — QR-menu platform for restaurants and hotels with a multi-tenant dashboard and billing. Case study: https://www.titanix.dev/work/skeniraj — Live: https://skeniraj.mk

## IoT lab work

- **Env Monitor Pro** — indoor/outdoor particulate (PM1/PM2.5/PM10) and humidity monitoring on Raspberry Pi with an OPC-N3 sensor and Grafana dashboards.
- **Edge LoRa Network** — low-power long-range sensor network on LilyGO T-Beam and Arduino Nano 33 BLE nodes.

## Notes

- You built an app with AI. Here is what App Review will look at: https://www.titanix.dev/notes/ai-built-app-app-store-rejections
- Apps that live outside the app (Lock Screen, widgets, Live Activities): https://www.titanix.dev/notes/apps-that-live-outside-the-app
- How the background of this site works (WebGL contour shader): https://www.titanix.dev/notes/how-the-background-of-this-site-works

## Offers (iOS)

- **App Rescue** (fixed scope) — for apps built with AI app builders or code editors (Lovable, Rork, Bolt, Cursor, Claude Code) or by a freelancer that are stuck: rejected, crashing, or a wrapped website. Titanix reads the code and the rejection first, keeps what can stay, rebuilds the key screens natively, adds StoreKit purchases, privacy and third-party AI disclosure, and handles submission and App Review replies. Fixed price. Request: https://www.titanix.dev/ship#rescue-form
- **App Launch Audit** (48 hours) — an app that is built or nearly built is put through the Titanix pre-submission check and launch review: App Review risks (privacy, permissions, subscriptions, sign-in, account deletion), paywall and pricing, App Store listing, leaked keys, crash risks and analytics. Result: a READY / NOT READY report with the fix for each problem. Fixed price.
- **Idea to App Store** (fixed scope) — the full process from idea check to a live, monetized native iOS app. Guarantee: if App Review rejects the app Titanix built, it is fixed and resubmitted at no extra cost until approved. Fixed price.
- Process and details: https://www.titanix.dev/ship (order the audit without a call: https://www.titanix.dev/ship#order)

## App Review rejection guides

Plain-English guides to the App Store Review Guidelines that reject apps most often (2.1, 2.3, 2.3.3, 3.1.1, 3.1.2, 4.3, 4.8, 5.1.1, 5.1.1(v), 4.2 Minimum Functionality, 1.2 User-Generated Content incl. AI content, 5.1.2(i) sharing data with third-party AI), with causes, fixes and what to tell App Review: https://www.titanix.dev/app-review

Free rejection-risk check (12 yes/no questions, runs in the browser): https://www.titanix.dev/app-review/check

## How we work

Discover (scope the v1) → Build the MVP (weekly working builds) → Launch (App Store review, listing, analytics, payments, deploy) → Grow (iterate on real usage). Engagements: fixed-scope MVP or an ongoing monthly partnership.
